# Implementation design preflight

The actual coordinator apply combines preparation and publication; its use for reservation makes Scene observers see the staged state. Implement private prepare/commit/abort within the existing owners, with a basis of Scene revision and semantic generation. Build detached SceneRecordStore, render, spatial-index, damage, invalidation and RuntimeScene publication state. Reserve all allocations and results before canonical writes. Prepare failure and abort must not change public Scene/RuntimeScene, Document, History, redo or observers. Commit the full local view only after the full canonical group succeeds and do not leave allocation or a recoverable failure in that post-write publication. Existing public single-operation behavior and recovery remain. Scene::publishStagedSnapshot currently copies invalidation vectors in a noexcept path; stage the necessary copies.

Concrete conditional owner findings: SceneRecordStore::commit inserts into live maps/arena and copies records despite noexcept; DirectRenderScene::commit inserts into its live map/vector and copies RenderRecord despite noexcept. These are authorized only to stage existing participant resources, and their headers/sources are locked as listed in implementation-context.json. No evidence presently establishes a need to alter the other conditional owners; if actual preparation or tests demonstrate such a need, stop for a new authorization rather than silently expanding. noexcept alone is not evidence of allocation-free behavior.

07-14 requires distinct ordered eligible per-operation notifications with actual IDs, generations, stamps and ChangeSets. LocalOperationSink delivers existing commit facts. A detached coherent Scene publication and separate ordered envelopes are the required design; compatibility of real callback timing and consumers is a P32 obligation, not proven by this P31. If that timing requires a partially visible Scene, stop as AUTHORITY_CONFLICT. Preserve no-interleaving and do not claim compensation rewinds canonical state. RuntimeScene basis and public snapshots must be tested at real boundaries, including failure injection and stale basis.

SCENE-PREP-01..06, the true grouped producer, and expanded OOM checks have not run. P31 preflight checks bindings and design evidence only.
